fields.statement: At 7e954a9, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ship-change.*|describe-golden)$' -count=1 passes (run-ship-change, -fail, -rebase, describe-golden). run-ship-change runs the built-in ship-change on two leaves (second depends on first) with fake rex/claude/gh: both built and verified in order, build/check then render then review/code and review/review, PR #7 opened once with the review summary as body, run stopped at signoff until rhiza run approve, then landed, merged and closed out. New in this fix: at sign-off a fresh git clone of the pushed cs/ship-it branch passes rhiza check. With the old render step (HEAD~1's ship-change.toml) in a throwaway worktree the same script fails at that clone check: 'extra: render does not write .rhiza/rendered/actor/claude-code-590c1440.md'. So the test catches the uncommitted actor records. Read the diff: the render step now stages and commits .rhiza/log with .rhiza/rendered, as Decision render-commits-actor-records rules. The leaf's statement now lists the render step, as Decision ship-change-file-names-render rules. TestShipChange* in internal/workflow finds no shipit in ship-change.toml or its steps. make check exits 0.
